In December, Wolfgang expressed his newfound interest in maintaining a good body shape and focusing on healthy eating habits. Two conversations stand out that highlight this concern:

Firstly, on December 23rd, Wolfgang shared his excitement about visiting Victoria Peak and trying dim sum in Hong Kong. He also mentioned his desire to "swing by Mong Kok" and taste the local street food. This conversation indicates Wolfgang's curiosity about the cuisine and possibly the calorie content of the food, reflecting his growing interest in healthier dietary choices.

Secondly, on December 24th, Wolfgang wished everyone a Merry Christmas and expressed his eagerness to jam with his bandmates and enjoy good tunes. During this conversation, Wolfgang also shared his love for gingerbread cookies and mentioned his willingness to take photos. However, it is the subsequent discussion about holiday treats and dishes that particularly shows his commitment to healthy eating. LiHua suggested that Wolfgang try egg waffles, honey glazed ham, and gingerbread cookies, which Wolfgang enthusiastically agreed to. This exchange suggests that Wolfgang was already aware of the importance of balancing traditional holiday treats with healthier options.

These two instances demonstrate Wolfgang's evolving interests and concerns about maintaining a good body shape and adopting healthier eating habits during the festive season.
